item.description: The highest reported death toll was in Pereira, in Colombia's coffee-growing region, where the mayor said 18 people died. The mayor of Cali, one of Colombia's largest cities, said people remained trapped after more than two dozen structures collapsed reut.rs/4zbmRNT
